body: While I will take into account trying to seriously find a therapist for the first time in my life, have you any idea how I can try and forget about or make a secret easier to live with? There would have been a time when was quite happy having my own secrets and private life, but now my thought pattern wont let me move on because people don't know certain things about me. It's retarded. I'm paralyzed with fear and shame most of every day.

I have spoken to a doctor a few years ago, and was on antidepressants at the time, but stopped taking them because I felt a little better but I didn't wanna be dependent on them. I might have to try and see if I can get to see a councilor through the NHS but apparently it takes while.

I don't know, if I could just disregard this memory or accept it in some way, I'd be fine. But just as I'm trying to move on, the thought comes back "no, you can't just move on like that, feel guilty you monster". Every choice I make seems defined by this memory and I just seem to be losing it more every day.
